items.title: Efficacy of low-dose methotrexate in rheumatoid arthritis.
items.journal: The New England journal of medicine
items.summary: Low-dose methotrexate (2.5-5 mg every 12 hours for three doses weekly) showed significant efficacy in refractory rheumatoid arthritis patients in a 24-week randomized double-blind crossover trial.

items.title: Treatment Guidelines in Rheumatoid Arthritis.
items.journal: Rheumatic diseases clinics of North America
items.summary: Treatment guidelines recommend starting effective DMARD treatment immediately, using methotrexate as initial therapy, and employing a treat-to-target strategy with rapid escalation if needed.

items.title: Novel treatment strategies in rheumatoid arthritis.
items.summary: Novel treatment strategies including targeted therapy approaches and treat-to-target monitoring can increase likelihood of remission in rheumatoid arthritis patients.

items.title: Safety and efficacy of upadacitinib in patients with active rheumatoid arthritis refractory to biologic disease-modifying anti-rheumatic drugs (SELECT-BEYOND): a double-blind, randomised controlled phase 3 trial.
items.summary: Upadacitinib, a selective JAK1 inhibitor, demonstrated safety and efficacy in patients with active rheumatoid arthritis refractory to biologic DMARDs in a phase 3 trial.

items.title: Adalimumab serum concentration to choose a subsequent biological DMARD in patients with rheumatoid arthritis (ADDORA-switch): results of a blinded randomised test-treatment trial.
items.summary: Therapeutic drug monitoring of adalimumab serum levels may help guide choice of subsequent biological DMARD in patients with rheumatoid arthritis who discontinue adalimumab due to ineffectiveness.

items.title: The efficacy and safety of Janus kinase inhibitors in adults with rheumatoid arthritis: a systematic review and cumulative meta-analysis.
items.summary: Systematic review and meta-analysis of JAK inhibitors in adults with rheumatoid arthritis examining efficacy and safety with most up-to-date data.

items.title: Safety, tolerability, and efficacy of pirfenidone in patients with rheumatoid arthritis-associated interstitial lung disease: a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 2 study.
items.summary: Pirfenidone failed to show efficacy for treatment of rheumatoid arthritis-associated interstitial lung disease in a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 2 trial.

items.title: Anti-GM-CSF otilimab versus sarilumab or placebo in patients with rheumatoid arthritis and inadequate response to targeted therapies: a phase III randomised trial (contRAst 3).
items.summary: Otilimab, an anti-GM-CSF antibody, failed to demonstrate superior efficacy compared to placebo in patients with rheumatoid arthritis and inadequate response to targeted therapies in phase III trial.

items.title: A double-blind placebo-controlled randomized trial of oral saffron in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis.
items.summary: Oral saffron showed no significant benefit over placebo in treating disease activity in newly diagnosed rheumatoid arthritis patients in a double-blind randomized trial.

items.title: A population-based cohort study of rheumatoid arthritis-associated interstitial lung disease: comorbidity and mortality.
items.summary: Population-based cohort study comparing mortality risks in patients with rheumatoid arthritis-associated interstitial lung disease versus RA patients without ILD.

items.title: Etiology and Pathogenesis of Rheumatoid Arthritis-Interstitial Lung Disease.
items.summary: Review of etiology and pathogenesis of rheumatoid arthritis-associated interstitial lung disease, highlighting increased mortality risk and poorly understood pathogenesis.

items.title: Risk of Major Adverse Cardiovascular Events in Immune-Mediated Inflammatory Disorders on Biologics and Small Molecules: Network Meta-Analysis.
items.journal: Clinical gastroenterology and hepatology : the official clinical practice journal of the American Gastroenterological Association
items.summary: Network meta-analysis examining major adverse cardiovascular events risk with biologics and small molecules including JAK inhibitors in immune-mediated inflammatory disorders.

canonicalFacts.claim: Methotrexate is the recommended first-line DMARD for rheumatoid arthritis treatment
Early diagnosis and treat-to-target approach with tight monitoring can increase likelihood of remission
Rheumatoid arthritis-associated interstitial lung disease significantly increases mortality risk
JAK inhibitors have demonstrated efficacy in rheumatoid arthritis but carry cardiovascular safety concerns
Therapeutic drug monitoring may help guide treatment decisions for patients failing adalimumab

lifestyleRecommendations.recommendation: Smoking cessation is important as smoking is associated with increased risk of RA-associated interstitial lung disease

redFlags: JAK inhibitors may increase risk of major adverse cardiovascular events
RA-associated interstitial lung disease significantly increases mortality risk
Cardiovascular disease is the leading cause of death in RA patients
